# Athlyte Search User Guide > Navigating Your Results > Game Dashboard

### Game Dashboard

Accessible from the search results, this dashboard provides a complete breakdown of a specific matchup:

- Individual Player Breakdown: Detailed statistical performance for every player on both teams for that specific game. Users can switch between stat categories (e.g., Rushing vs. Receiving) using a dropdown.
- Team Stats Comparison: A side-by-side view of team-level statistics, allowing you to compare how the home and away teams performed across all categories.
- Game Rosters: View the full list of players available for both teams. A toggle allows you to switch between viewing only the starters or the full roster.

## Visualize Data

The "Visualize Data" feature adds simple visual representations to search results. After performing a search, users can click the "Visualize Data" button near the results table to display a chart based on the selected query and relevant period (game or season).

The type of queries supported for this are:

- Simple
- Complex
- Records
- Last Time When
- Streaks

**Simple:** For basic queries (e.g., "players with rushing yards > 50"), a horizontal bar chart shows the top 10 players who met the condition the most number of times. No. of occurrences shows how often each player achieved the stat.

**Complex:** For queries with more than one condition (e.g., "players with rushing yards > 50 and passing yards > 10"), a scatter plot shows the top 10 players who met both conditions most frequently.

**Records (Min & Max):** For record-based queries (e.g., "highest rushing yards in a game"), a line chart takes the first 10 entries from the results table (even if the same player appears more than once) and plots each player's record game in the center, with up to 3 games before and 3 games after.

#### 3.4.1 Team Dashboard

Team Statistics
The "Team Statistics" section of a team's dashboard offers an overview of the seasonal stats of the team. The aggregate statistics for every season can be viewed.

Filters: These stats can be filtered based on season, stat category, and substat.

Team Records
This page details a team's performance, including the stat name, value, rank, and the stat value of the rank above. It also displays the game date for each statistic and the opponent's team.

Filters: These stats can be filtered based on period, season, stat category, and substat.

Season Highs
Displays the highest value achieved by the team for each statistic in a season, as well as the game date on which it was recorded.

Filters: These stats can be filtered based on season, stat category, and substat.

Team Game Logs
Gives a complete list of all games played by the team in a season, including the opposing team, result, and score for each game.

Filters: These stats can be filtered based on season, stat category, and substat.

Team Streaks
Team Streaks provides information on a team's statistical performance for all stats across consecutive games.

# Athlyte Search User Guide > Navigating Your Results > Player Dashboard

### Player Dashboard

Clicking on any player's name opens their dedicated dashboard, which is broken down into several powerful sections:

- Player Statistics: A seasonal overview showing aggregate stats for every year of their career. You can filter these by season and category (e.g., Passing, Defense).
- Player Records: A deep dive into individual game performances. This section shows the player's rank for specific stats and even identifies the "value to beat" for the rank immediately above them.
- Season & Career Highs: Quickly view the best mark a player has ever achieved in a single game, either within a specific season or across their entire career, including the date and opponent.
- Player Game Log: A complete list of every game played in a selected season, providing a chronological view of their performance.
- Player Streaks: Analyzes performances across consecutive games to identify consistent high-level play.

Source: Athlyte-Search-User-Guide.md

### Sidebar Filters

You can refine your results instantly using the sidebar without re-typing your query. These filters apply to all query types except Streaks:

- Opponent & Conference: Filter by a specific opponent team or an entire conference (e.g., SEC, Big Ten).
- Game Result: Narrow results to only Wins or Losses.
- Game Type: Toggle between Regular Season and Post-season games.
- Date Range: Specify custom start and end dates to see stats from a particular timeframe.
- Player Metadata: Filter by Name, Position (e.g., QB, Guard), or Class year (Freshman, Sophomore, Junior, Senior).
- Period Type: Filter by specific parts of the game like first half or overtime.

## Types of Queries You Can Use

- Basic Query: Simple lookups (e.g., "Who had 10+ points?")
- Complex Query: Combining multiple conditions or filters (e.g., "Juniors with 20+ points and 10+ rebounds against Duke")
- Record Query: Finding the best or worst (e.g., "Highest points in a game" or "Who has the record for assists?")
- Last Time Was (LTW): Looking up history (e.g., "Last time a team had 50+ rebounds?")
- Streak Query: Finding consecutive performance (e.g., "3+ consecutive games with a touchdown")

#### 3.1.4 Athlyte Query Language (AQL)

Here a natural language query is transformed into a structured query language (Athlyte Query Language) that a computer program or database can easily understand and execute to fetch the correct information.
This is the standard format for AQL:
{"query_type": , "entity": , "qualifiers": , "stat_period": , "conditions": , "streak_len": , "periods":, "period_type": }
Example:
User Query: The highest punt returns yards accomplished during a season
AQL : {"query_type": "max", "entity": "player", "qualifiers": {}, "stat_period": "season", "conditions": "s_punt_returns_yards", "streak_len": null, "periods": null, "period_type": null}
